clusters.title: Kharkongngor & Kharshi-ïing
clusters.summary_khasi: Mih na ka Mei-Ïawbei 'Mei Moh Kynhong' (~1450 AD) ha Nongkyntir kaba la shongkha bad u Step na ka kur Ryndem. Ki Kharkongngor ki ïakam kur bad ki Kharshi-ïing.
clusters.summary_english: Descends from 'Mei Moh Kynhong' (~1450 AD) in Nongkyntir. Kharkongngor maintains an ïakam kur pact with Kharshi-ïing.
